primitives.name: Error Comprehension Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters Users need to find value in 10 seconds.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{\\text{comprehend}}': 'time in seconds, T_{\\text{comprehend}} \\leq 10', 'H': 'information entropy in bits'}
primitives.assumptions: User attention is bounded; error state must be semantically distinct; cognitive load scales inversely with visual clarity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When H(T_{\text{comprehend}} > 10) exceeds threshold, comprehension fails.

layer2.mapping: Comprehension kernel maps to a rate-limited information channel with entropy constraint; GSI models belief updates via Bayesian inference; GSE executes state transitions based on action-value estimates.
layer2.telemetry: Time-to-understand metric, entropy of help content, visual clarity score.

primitives.name: Trust-Safe Visual Path
primitives.verbatim_quote: GSE is proprietary and complex, so every major item needs an immediate explanation, a next action, and a trust-safe media or visual path.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'V': 'visual fidelity index, 0 ≤ V ≤ 1', 'A': 'actionability score, 0 ≤ A ≤ 1', 'T': 'trust signal strength, 0 ≤ T ≤ 1'}
primitives.assumptions: Visual fidelity correlates with trust; actionability is context-sensitive; trust signal is encoded in media metadata.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T(V,A) < 0.5, user disengages or seeks external help.

layer2.mapping: Derived from error state and user intent; visual path encodes trust-safe affordances; GSI evaluates trustworthiness via embedded metadata; GSE triggers media rendering based on trust-state.
layer2.telemetry: Trust score from user feedback loop, media render success rate, engagement duration.

primitives.name: Help Asset Pipeline
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Internal Value Galaxy Studios, support, product, and growth teams get a repeatable help asset pipeline instead of one-off explanations.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{\\text{asset}}': 'pipeline throughput in assets per hour', 'R_{\\text{reusable}}': 'reusability ratio, 0 ≤ R_{\\text{reusable}} ≤ 1'}
primitives.assumptions: Asset reuse reduces redundancy; pipeline is modular and scalable; internal teams share common schema.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P_{\text{asset}} drops below threshold, team velocity degrades.

layer2.mapping: Pipeline mirrors dataflow in GSE; each asset is a state transition; GSI ensures semantic consistency across assets; GSE orchestrates asset delivery via event-driven architecture.
layer2.telemetry: Asset creation time, reusability rate, team adoption metrics.
